bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
app="$root/.worktrees/profile-live-20261114"
compose="$app/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml"
test "$(git -C "$app" rev-parse HEAD)" = "6445896df387d290b6a0517d8cdb72c0471db4c7" || exit 70
test -z "$(git -C "$app" status --porcelain)" || exit 71
live="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)"
tagged="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local)"
expected="sha256:e110d14ad7feeb8ebb1adcc79a65534f16f540b639dfd22f7a713e3bbf36c6fa"
test "$live" = "$expected" && test "$tagged" = "$expected" || exit 72
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1)" = true || exit 73
test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt" && test -r "$root/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" || exit 74
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
gh run download 43574339239 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --name gaybbs-profile-bundle --dir "$tmp" >/dev/null
test "$(sha256sum "$tmp/gaybbs.mjs" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "69b936caef09c1586a99a1ed6b42f13f8cb97be64cd0b2fbbe3336fe062a8228" || exit 75
printf 'FROM gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local\nCOPY --chown=1000:1000 gaybbs.mjs /app/gaybbs.mjs\n' > "$tmp/Dockerfile"
docker build --network none --pull=false -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:chat-selector-f568489 -f "$tmp/Dockerfile" "$tmp" >/dev/null
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:chat-selector-f568489 --check /app/gaybbs.mjs >/dev/null
candidate="$(docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:chat-selector-f568489)"
printf 'secrets:\n  db_password:\n    file: %s\n  bot_token:\n    file: %s\n' "$root/deploy/secrets/db_password.txt" "$root/deploy/secrets/bot_token.txt" > "$tmp/override.yaml"
docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" config -q >/dev/null
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-chat-selector-f568489
docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:chat-selector-f568489 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
rollback(){ docker tag gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-chat-selector-f568489 gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local; docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
if ! docker compose -p deploy -f "$compose" -f "$tmp/override.yaml" up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null; then rollback; exit 81; fi
sleep 8
actual="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo absent)"
running="$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1 2>/dev/null || echo false)"
if test "$actual" != "$candidate" || test "$running" != true; then rollback; exit 82; fi
{ echo "CHAT_SELECTOR_DEPLOY=PASS"; echo "SOURCE_HEAD=f568489b4a04d51a70c77ace8b6bd4b011df0efe"; echo "IMAGE=$actual"; echo "RUNNING=true"; echo "OLD_IMAGE=$expected"; echo "MENU_LINKS=3"; } | gh issue comment 7 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
